findings.finding: Open API exists as a published product claim, not an openly documented endpoint contract.

authorized_followup_checklist.request: Confirm permitted evaluation/integration purpose and scope in writing before authenticated competitive analysis; request vendor-sanctioned synthetic-data sandbox if appropriate.
authorized_followup_checklist.why: Published terms restrict competitive reconstruction and third-party access.

authorized_followup_checklist.request: Obtain current API/OpenAPI documentation, supported API version, authentication/scopes, tenant boundaries, service-account policy, rate limits and production/sandbox separation.
authorized_followup_checklist.why: Open API claim does not define a usable adapter.

authorized_followup_checklist.request: Request sample synthetic schemas for requisitions, candidates/submissions, assignments, credentials, timesheets, invoices, suppliers, clients and program settings, including immutable identifiers and state diagrams.
authorized_followup_checklist.why: Converts public domain concepts into testable mappings.

authorized_followup_checklist.request: Ask for webhook/event catalog, delivery/retry semantics, deletion/change feeds, idempotency and reconciliation support.
authorized_followup_checklist.why: Determines whether AI workers can operate reliably without duplicate submissions or invoices.

authorized_followup_checklist.request: Demonstrate role-specific create/read/approve permissions using synthetic records; export/import supported formats and data-portability terms.
authorized_followup_checklist.why: Support categories alone do not establish permissions or field-level access.

authorized_followup_checklist.request: For a permitted sample program, identify actual VMS vendor and supplier onboarding route; obtain redacted business rules for distribution, submissions, approval, invoicing and service-level escalations.
authorized_followup_checklist.why: Do not generalize one education deployment across all programs.

authorized_followup_checklist.request: Request an expressly permitted synthetic-data clinician/admin demonstration, integration architecture, API/export availability and account/room access model.
authorized_followup_checklist.why: Public room-link description does not expose an authorized test room.

authorized_followup_checklist.request: Reconcile no student-session-storage claims with activity/minute reporting, and clarify assessment/resource licenses and clinical-system boundaries.
authorized_followup_checklist.why: Needed to design reporting independently without inventing storage behavior or copying licensed assessment content.

research_limits: No public API specification found in the inspected published pages and focused search results; this does not prove none exists.
MatterWorx app shell is reachable through ordinary HTTP retrieval, but the in-app browser could not load it; application functionality remains untested.
Python urllib initially lacked local certificate-chain trust across all sampled domains; validated curl succeeded. No TLS validation was disabled.
Only officially linked route followed for app access. Bundle code and protected endpoints were not analyzed.
No named ATP video backend inferred from marketing similarities.
next_reconstruction_step: Use the public object/role map to design an independent interface contract; keep vendor-specific adapters blocked on published documentation or expressly authorized integration access.
